text:
marc (oncall): Pager triggered: significant quality regression observed on /v1/generate for customers pinned to model redwood-3b-v2 after the 03:12 deploy. Error rates up ~18% on eval set, customer complaints starting. Investigating.

inc-bot: ALERT: #pager - priority P1 - regression-detect-binary - paging marc (oncall), sara (eng-runtime). Link: https://ops.example.com/incidents/1968004321

sara (eng-runtime): grabbing logs now. initial hypothesis: kernel selector switched quant path for redwood-3b-v2 on newer runtime build. 

alex (sre): I see increased 5xx + bad-token outputs in the metrics dashboard. Canary was green for perf but not whole eval suite. Do we want to roll back runtime or pin model to stable variant?

marc (oncall): pin-first approach recommended to reduce customer impact quickly. Can we pin affected customers to redwood-3b-v1 (known-good) while we debug runtime? Need quick comms for status page + customer-facing note.

sara (eng-runtime): I can push a model pin policy for requests routed via the routing layer. ETA ~8m to apply a canary pin at edge and 15m to roll to all regions. Command I will run:```
# pin redwood-3b-v1 for tenant group "prod-ml"
redwoodctl routing pin --model redwood-3b-v1 --selector prod-ml --scope region:all --reason "regression after 03:12 runtime deploy"
```

alex (sre): tagging along for rollout. I'll start a smoke job to validate outputs post-pin.

sam (support): drafting customer note. Suggest wording: "We detected model output quality issues after a recent runtime update affecting some requests. We are pinning affected customers to a stable model variant and will follow up with timelines and root cause. No data was exfiltrated. If you see degraded behavior please reply to this thread or open a support case." Any legal/security flags?

ben (product): boil it down: impact, mitigation (pin), ETA for fix (investigating, possibly 24-72h), and ask customers to report specific examples. + offer to revert pin if it causes other regressions.

marc (oncall): agreed. Sara, proceed with pin canary. Alex run validation. Ben + Sam please co-author the status page and customer note. I'll coordinate handoff to night oncall in 40m if this persists.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK NOTE saved to incident 1968004321: mitigation=pinned-model, rollback_option=runtime-revert.

sara (eng-runtime): canary pin applied to us-west1. Observability: error rate dropped ~12% in canary traffic and baseline metrics looking closer to green. Rolling to all regions now.

alex (sre): smoke results: token-level perplexity and chat continuity tests passed on sampled traffic pinned to redwood-3b-v1. No elevated 5xx.

marc (oncall): excellent. Proceeding to update status page. Draft status page update: "We detected a model output regression impacting the redwood-3b-v2 model after a routine runtime deploy at 03:12 UTC. Mitigation: affected customers have been temporarily pinned to redwood-3b-v1, which restores expected output quality. Investigation in progress. We will provide a follow-up with root cause and timeline. Reach out to support for urgent impacts." Approve?

ben (product): approve. Add: "Potentially affected endpoints: /v1/generate, chat endpoints using redwood-3b-v2."

sam (support): customer-facing email draft: "Hi — we identified an issue after a recent platform update that changed model behavior for some requests. We've temporarily pinned affected traffic to a stable model (redwood-3b-v1) while we investigate. We expect further updates within 24 hours; please reply with examples if you see incorrect outputs. — Redwood Inference Support"

marc (oncall): ok publish status page, send batch of proactive emails to top 20 affected customers (Sam/Ben to own), and escalate to engineering postmortem owners for RCA once we have root cause signals. I'm going to start the handoff note for night oncall now.

marc (oncall): HANDOFF (if still open at 20:00 UTC): summary=quality-regression-post-deploy, mitigation=pinned to redwood-3b-v1 (global), next-steps=runtime rollback if QA finds kernel regression, contacts=sara, alex, ben, sam, commander=marc. Prefix logs at https://logs.example.com/stream?i=1968004321

sara (eng-runtime): collecting runtime traces and kernel selection logs now. if we confirm selector bug we will prepare a rollback PR for the 03:12 build.

alex (sre): leaving monitoring alerts adjusted for pinned traffic; will keep a watch on error budgets. set up auto-notify to #eng-oncall if error rate rises past 2% above baseline.

ben (product): added customer email list and scheduled send in 10m. Sam will review first.

sam (support): sent customer emails to top 20, queued transactional note for self-serve customers in-app. Copy of email saved to incident 1968004321 thread.

marc (oncall): final status for now: mitigation applied, customers pinned, smoke tests look good, drafting RCA timeline. Will update thread with root cause when available. Leaving open for night handoff. :white_check_mark:

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation=pin_applied, status=monitoring, incident_id=1968004321

sara (eng-runtime): quick note for handoff: traces show kernel-selection path changed when runtime detected 8-bit quant heuristic for redwood-3b-v2. Repro locally. Building a minimal test to confirm.

alex (sre): thumbs for visibility. I'll be on call in case of rollbacks.

ben (product): thanks team. Sam please escalate any high-severity customer replies directly to me.

sam (support): will do.

marc (oncall): handing off in 40m if no regressions reappear. If any customer reports continued bad outputs, escalate immediate page and re-run pin. Closing interim updates here."
